note: _nos cognovimus et credidimus caritati quam habet Deus in nobis_ – we have known and have believed in the love that God has for us. The NVg changes to _nos, qui credidimus, novimus caritatem_ (…) – we who have believed, know the love (…).

_si quis dixerit quoniam diligo deum_ – if any man say: I love God (Douay Version). The word _quoniam_ is not to be translated, for it simply serves as the particle that announces a quotation, reflecting the Greek ὅτι. – Kaulen, p. 290.
